label: Load Asset
description: Bring an existing asset into the workflow: by library id, or by importing a file from disk.

inputs.name: in
inputs.label: Asset ID or Path
inputs.description: Overrides the configured asset at runtime.

outputs.name: text
outputs.label: Text
outputs.description: File contents, for text and JSON assets.

outputs.name: kind
outputs.label: Kind
outputs.description: text, image, mesh, audio, video, json or file.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: Error
outputs.description: Error message if the step failed. Wire it to handle failures yourself; leave it unwired and the node fails visibly instead.
